_comment: Accepted npm audit advisories (production deps). Each entry needs a reason tied to how Beacon uses the package and a review date. scripts/check-audit.ts fails on any high/critical advisory not listed here, and on entries past their review date.

GHSA-effect-templateliteral-redos.reason: Transitive via prisma CLI config loading (@prisma/client -> prisma -> @prisma/config). Not reachable from request handling; schemas are not built from user input. Fixed by the Prisma 7 upgrade.

deepmerge-ts-stack-exhaustion.reason: Transitive via prisma CLI config loading. Only merges Prisma's own configuration objects, never user data. Fixed by the Prisma 7 upgrade.
